title: Matters not provided for.
officialText:
Any matter or requirement essential for fire or structural safety or essential for the safety or
health of the occupants or users of a structure or the public, and which is not covered by the provisions of this code or other applicable
laws and rules, shall be subject to determination and requirements by the commissioner in specific cases.
